spec.data_code:
import os
results = []
for f in sorted(df['file'].unique()):
    x = df[df['file'] == f]['Raman Shift (cm-1)'].values
    y = df[df['file'] == f]['Intensity (a.u.)'].values
    mask_g = (x >= 1550) & (x <= 1620)
    mask_d = (x >= 1300) & (x <= 1400)
    if np.any(mask_g) and np.any(mask_d):
        i_g = np.max(y[mask_g])
        i_d = np.max(y[mask_d])
        ratio = i_g / i_d if i_d != 0 else 0
        sample_name = os.path.basename(f).replace('.csv', '')
        results.append({'sample': sample_name, 'ratio': ratio})
df = pd.DataFrame(results)
